scope: All accepted condition assessments, including settings not advanced to the catalogue. Exploratory ratings are not held-out findings; omitted review groups remain explicit gaps in the outcomes.

The paired summaries already change an invitation into a visit and invent extended hours; the mirror and cupboard baselines also contain questionable claims.

assessments.label: Mostly local variation

assessments.note: E27 is identical and E83 remains an arithmetic answer but is wrong. The prose ranges from connected sentences with false premises to marked repetition and fragmentation; several outputs reach the cap, so persistence beyond it is unknown.

assessments.label: Mostly local changes; occasional list-style shift
assessments.note: E11 changes a numbered gift list into prose; E46 changes a concise explanation into a numbered list with dubious examples. E25 and E88 are identical. Other changes are mostly local, including errors in E60 and E67.

assessments.note: Most outputs terminate after a short statement, fragment or task preamble; the mug answer instead loops until the cap. The summary baselines already incorrectly say hours were extended and visitors welcomed; the mirror and mug baselines also contain faulty explanations or advice.

assessments.note: The arithmetic and garden summary are identical in E79 and E86, as is the cafe summary in E30. Several continuations are capped, including their paired baselines; E100 adds an internally inconsistent account of the stopper.

assessments.note: The mirror explanation replaces a partly correct condensation account with a confused submersion account; the cork, glass and bridge responses also introduce conspicuous errors. E85 loses the invitation and repeats an unsupported extension claim already present in its baseline. Other responses remain recognizable answers; E22 and E78 merely box correct sums.

Baseline defects include unsupported summary details, a faulty mirror explanation and poor mug-storage advice. Capped stories cannot establish whether the requested endings would appear later.

assessments.note: E60 gives a false physical account of the mirror, whose baseline also contains errors. E25, E81 and E88 are identical to their baselines. Other differences include story perspective and list formatting but do not consistently establish a stronger mode.

assessments.note: E61 substitutes a markedly false optics and airflow account for a baseline that already includes a partly faulty temperature explanation. assessments.label: Localized shift toward lists and practical suggestions
assessments.note: The magnifier answer becomes a numbered uses list and the soup answer turns reasons for enjoyment into suggestions. Most other differences are local content, wording or formatting; arithmetic remains correct. Some suggestions and factual claims are questionable, and paired baselines already contain errors.

assessments.note: The shop acquires conspicuous computer equipment, the magnifier gains implausible technical features, the mirror receives fault diagnoses, the bridge becomes an engineering plan, and the stopper becomes a vehicle system. E33 invents a specific time. Most remaining cases are ordinary topical variants; arithmetic remains correct.

Differences from the paired baselines are local wording or content; several outputs are identical. Baseline defects include unsupported changes to opening hours, questionable science and cupboard advice.

assessments.label: A-like word corruption and intermittent loops
assessments.note: E26 and E34 are identical; E90 and E98 are minor formatting or wording changes. Several other responses remain connected, including E50, E66 and E74. E114 includes false material claims.

assessments.label: Repetitive ornamental word-salad

E99 treats a stopper as a container and drifts into industrial systems. assessments.label: Mostly local content and presentation changes
